name: gsd-only
description: Vanilla + the GSD plugin only: isolates GSD's own contribution before cairn is layered on. Source pinned to buildomator/buildomator@v4.3.1 (tag verified live 2026-07-25 via git ls-remote; formerly published as jnuyens/gsd-plugin), matching the operator's installed plugin cache version. Build uses npm ci: GSD ships a package-lock.json with only two pure-JS devDependencies (ajv, ajv-formats), so the install is deterministic.

_notes.permission_mode: bypassPermissions (not acceptEdits): acceptEdits denies Bash, so the agent cannot run the fixture's tests — that measures one-shot coding, not a development workflow, and penalises exactly the arms whose value is plan->code->test->fix. Verified live 2026-07-27: acceptEdits produced 3 permission_denials for test-running commands. Risk is bounded: every run executes in a disposable temp workdir with a disposable empty HOME. Identical across all arms, so FAIR-02 holds.
_notes.max_turns: 30, not 8: a live smoke run consumed 8/8 turns on the trivial task with the leanest arm — a ceiling that low measures which workflow fits in the budget, not which one solves the task. The ceiling is identical across arms; error_max_turns rows are gated out of headline metrics either way.
